# MockFlow

> MockFlow is an AI-powered online wireframing and whiteboard collaboration platform for visual design, planning, and team brainstorming across web, mobile, and enterprise applications.

MockFlow provides two core products—WireframePro for UI/UX wireframing with code export capabilities, and IdeaBoard for real-time collaborative whiteboarding and diagramming. The platform serves diverse user segments including enterprises, startups, agencies, freelancers, educators, and remote teams with integrated AI planning tools and seamless integrations with popular design and productivity software.
